subject: Request: Secure dev evidence handoff and walkthrough plan (SIG-lite intake)
messages:
From: Natalie Ruiz <natalie.ruiz@finsecure.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: SOC Assessor <assess@auditco.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Secure dev evidence for SIG-lite intake (FinSecure)

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for taking this — FinSecure's compliance team opened a SIG-lite intake to validate a few Secure SDLC controls before we proceed to procurement. We need a compact evidence bundle focused on code review, CI/CD controls, secrets management, and change approvals. Our assessor listed the following as must-haves for the initial pass: 

- PR review policy and a recent PR sampling (sanitized diffs are fine)
- CI pipeline manifests for main branches (showing gating and required checks)
- Ephemeral credential usage and rotation logs (last 90 days)
- KMS/key rotation summary and rotation schedule
- Change approval history for releases in the last 6 months (reviewer + approver records)
- Description of how prefix/KV caching and automated rollbacks are handled (short write-up)

We attached a short questionnaire (finsecure_SIG_questions_v1.pdf). Please indicate which artifacts you can provide by next Tuesday (11/28) and whether you need any redaction guidance. Also confirm delivery format (zip vs shared drive) and if a brief walkthrough is possible.

Best,
Natalie Ruiz
Security Assessment Lead
FinSecure Inc.

Attachment: finsecure_SIG_questions_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 184 KB)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Ruiz <natalie.ruiz@finsecure.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Secure dev evidence for SIG-lite intake (FinSecure)

Hi Natalie — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble a focused bundle and can meet your 11/28 target. Proposed mutual action plan: 

1) By 11/23 EOD: Provide a mapping document that ties the questionnaire items to our artifacts and the location (drive paths).
2) By 11/27 EOD: Upload sanitized artifacts and logs for assessor review (90-day windows where applicable).
3) 11/28 (30-45 min): Walkthrough meeting to step through artifacts and answer assessor questions.

Artifacts we will include in the initial upload (preliminary names):
- pr_review_log_2028Q3.csv — sample PR metadata and reviewer fields (sanitized IDs)
- ci_manifest_2028-11.yaml — canonical pipeline for main/release branches (annotated)
- kms_rotation_summary_2028.pdf — rotation schedule and last rotation evidence
- change_approvals_export_2028.csv — approvals export (IDs + timestamps; we can redact emails)
- short_writeup_secure_dev_controls.txt — how we enforce gating, caching, rollback policies

A couple of clarifications we need from you so we prepare the right formats: 
- For PR samples, is a single sanitized diff plus the PR metadata sufficient, or do you prefer a batch of 5 PRs?
- For ephemeral credential logs: do you need raw token issuance events (we can provide an anonymized log) or summarized rotation snapshots?

Delivery preference: we typically share via a secure Drive folder and provide a signed integrity manifest (SHA256 list). If you require an encrypted ZIP, we can do that too — let us know.

I'll loop Irene (security engineering) and Lauren (compliance ops) — they will own the upload.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Manager, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pr_review_log_2028Q3.csv (text/csv), ci_manifest_2028-11.yaml (text/yaml), kms_rotation_summary_2028.pdf (application/pdf), change_approvals_export_2028.csv (text/csv)

From: Natalie Ruiz <natalie.ruiz@finsecure.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: SOC Assessor <assess@auditco.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Secure dev evidence for SIG-lite intake (FinSecure)

Hi Mateo — this plan works. Quick answers: 

- PR sampling: please provide 5 PRs if feasible (sanitized diffs + metadata). The assessor will spot-check the review threads and required approver checks.
- Ephemeral credentials: the assessor prefers issuance/rotation events (anonymized) plus a short diagram of the lifecycle (how tokens are minted, TTL, revocation). A short demo of ephemeral token rotation during the walkthrough would be very helpful but not required for the initial pass.
- Logs: 90-day raw events are preferred; if there are privacy constraints, a sampled anonymized log with counts and examples is acceptable.

Delivery: Drive is fine — please make the folder viewable to assess@auditco.com and natalie.ruiz@finsecure.com. We will confirm encryption needs if our procurement team requires it.

One more ask: can you include a short statement clarifying your sanitization/redaction methodology so the assessor can validate that critical fields were not removed?

Thanks,
Natalie

P.S. Our intake tracker ID is HS-78904 — please reference that in the upload.

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Ruiz <natalie.ruiz@finsecure.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Nov 2028 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Secure dev evidence for SIG-lite intake (FinSecure)

Hi Natalie — all set. Summary of next steps and links below: 

Deliverables we will upload by 11/27 EOD (shared Drive + integrity manifest):
- 5 sanitized PR samples (zip) — filenames: pr_samples_001-005_sanitized.zip
- pr_review_log_2028Q3.csv (metadata export)
- ci_manifest_2028-11.yaml (annotated pipeline)
- kms_rotation_summary_2028.pdf
- ephemeral_tokens_90d_sample.log (anonymized)
- change_approvals_export_2028.csv
- sanitization_methodology.txt (describes redaction rules and fields preserved)

Drive link (will be shared with assess@auditco.com & natalie.ruiz@finsecure.com): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbC-example-share
HubSpot intake: HS-78904
Walkthrough proposed: Tue 2028-11-28, 09:00 PT (30 min) — please confirm and we will send an invite.

If you confirm the walkthrough I will add Laura Bennett (Head of Trust) to the session for any high-level questions.

Thanks — we appreciate the clear scope. If the assessor needs any live queries against logs during the walkthrough we can run read-only queries and share results in real time (no production writes).

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Manager, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
